products.label: PDS Rings Node Neptune ring table
products.process: Choose a ring in proportion to its opacity, 1 - exp(-tau), times its published width times its radius; place a dot in Neptune's ring plane within that width; repeat 600 times. The dot's longitude and its place across the width come from a seeded generator.
limitations: No ring particle has a measured position. Only each ring's share of the dots is measured; each dot's longitude is drawn from a seeded generator.
Neptune's rings are nearly invisible at their true opacity; the 600 dots are a display choice. At the density of Saturn's dots Neptune would have none.
The Adams ring's arcs are not drawn: the table gives no longitudes for them at this epoch.
